Bill of Materials

Gather all of the following before you begin. Links are provided for reference; equivalent parts from other suppliers will work.

Item Quantity Source Approx. Price Notes
3D Printing
3D printer 1

Any FDM printer with ≥15 cm build plate
PLA/PETG filament ~Xg

Colour of your choice
Structural Components
MakerBeam 30 cm 4 Link €X
MakerBeam tapered bolts 4 Link €X
MakerBeam standard bolts 8 Link €X
MakerBeam nuts X Link €X
Lighting
IR LED strip 1 roll

850 nm or 940 nm; need 40 cm total
End click connector 1

Must match strip width
Corner click connectors 3

Must match strip width
12V power supply 1

For LED strips
Assembly Supplies
Neodymium magnets (Ø6 x 2 mm) X

Quantity depends on configuration
Superglue (cyanoacrylate) 1

Gorilla Glue or similar
Diffuser fabric 1 piece

White ripstop nylon or similar; ~20 x 15 cm
Small cable ties ~10

For cable management
Disposable gloves 1 pair

Nitrile or latex
Paper towels A few sheets

For wiping excess glue
Stanley knife / scissors 1

For cutting LED strips and fabric
